description: Department  of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare that a Cess be charged, levied and paid on Meat, Fish, etc. w.e.f. 12.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains an order under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, imposing a cess (tax) on imported goods. It establishes new regulatory requirements, specifies tax rates, and provides exemptions - all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content focuses entirely on creating and modifying legal financial obligations for imports.
